outreach_draft.subject: A thought on your Estate Planning & Probate page
outreach_draft.body:
David, I was looking through Groom Law Firm’s current site and noticed that Estate Planning & Probate, Business Law, Real Estate, Litigation and Tax Law are all presented together on the main website conversation rather than through separate focused service destinations. Those clients arrive with very different questions and intent. A dedicated Estate Planning & Probate page could give that audience a much clearer path from first visit to consultation, with the right issues, proof and next steps in one place. It would also create a cleaner focused context for Google and for AI systems trying to understand exactly what the firm offers. I’d start with Estate Planning & Probate because it is a distinct consumer journey from the firm’s business and real-estate work and makes the architectural opportunity easy to see. I’m putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I’ll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you’d rather I didn’t, just let me know.
